description: Site-wide configuration: entry multipliers, FOMO texts, social links, legal disclaimer.

endpoints.description: Get the current site configuration. Public endpoint (no auth required).

schema.legalDisclaimer: string (DO NOT MODIFY — required by US law)

en.cartUpsell: Add ${amount} more to unlock the VIP PACK!

es.cartUpsell: ¡Agrega ${amount} USD más para desbloquear el PACK VIP!

example.legalDisclaimer: No Purchase Necessary. Must be 18+ to enter. See Official Rules for details.

endpoints.description: Update site configuration (admin only). Partial updates supported.

requestBody.description: Partial config object — only send fields that need updating.

businessRules: CRITICAL: defaultEntryMultiplier drives the entire entry calculation system. Changing this affects all new orders.
The legalDisclaimer text is required by US sweepstakes law — DO NOT allow it to be deleted or emptied.
fomoTexts are bilingual (EN/ES) and used across the UI for urgency messaging.
The ${amount} template variable in cartUpsell is replaced by the frontend with the remaining amount for free shipping.
Config is a singleton (one object, not an array). There is only one config document.
Changes to config take effect immediately — the frontend fetches config on app startup.
